gaps.row: 结果 1、结果 2 — turn-judge `before()` 的 `用户在ask中回答` 条目与 `livePrompts()` 的 `{{ask_answers}}` 渲染
gaps.input: A session branch whose tool results are `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"db","question":"Database","answer":"SQLite"}]}}` and `{"toolName":"ask","isError":false,"details":{"answers":[{"name":"ticks","question":"Backfill","answer":"no"}],"timedOut":true}}`, read through agent/extensions/turn-judge/index.ts:565 and agent/extensions/user-prompt-inject/index.ts:301 — no acceptance command calls either consumer (the driver only reads the persisted path, transcript.ts:308-315 and 349-359); the tree's overall acceptance issue #337 is what observes these two surfaces in a real session.

rulings.decision: A whitespace-only native `answer` is blank and is skipped. Native answer text is folded first (runs of whitespace incl. newlines/tabs → one space, trimmed); an answer that is empty after folding is 未作答. With that as the only entry, `askAnswers` returns null.
rulings.basis: Contract decision row 「原生答案为空时的表现」: "空白答案按未作答跳过；全部为空或 `answers: []` 返回 `null`"; the existing code already treats blank legacy input the same way (`answerOf` trims `customInput` and returns null when nothing is left, so the entry is dropped). Treating `"   "` as an answer would produce the `question → ` content-free line that the row rejects as 「没有内容的『回答』」.

rulings.decision: No deduplication: one output line per non-blank `answers[]` entry, in host order, even when two entries have the same `name` and `question`. A note pairs with every entry whose `name` and `question` both match it.
rulings.basis: Contract 结果 1: "`details.answers[]` 里的每个作答问题在 `formatAskAnswers` 输出中占一行 … `askAnswers` 返回全部作答" — the host emits one `FormAnswer` per field (data.ts:230-243) and `askAnswers` returns all of them; dropping an entry would lose an operator submission the host recorded, and the nearest similar case (legacy `results[]`, which is also not deduplicated) keeps every entry.

rulings.decision: The one-line-per-question rule holds for native answers: the answer text is folded the same way note text is (newlines and runs of whitespace become a single space, trimmed). The fold applies only to `answers[]` text; legacy `results[]`/single-question parsing stays byte-for-byte as the base commit (结果 4), so a legacy `customInput` is not folded.
rulings.basis: Contract 结果 1: "每个作答问题在 `formatAskAnswers` 输出中占一行 `question → answer`" and 目标 "每个作答问题一行"; the consumers (turn-judge before(), livePrompts(), transcript answerTexts()) join `formatAskAnswers` output as-is, so a textarea newline would otherwise break the line contract. Nearest similar case: the decision table folds 换行与连续空白 to one space for note text. 结果 4 [保持] limits the fold to the new shape.

rulings.decision: A `notes` array in which no entry pairs with an answer changes nothing: the output equals the one without `notes`, and the orphan note is not printed.
rulings.basis: 结果 3: "没有 `notes`、备注全部配不上、或备注文本折叠后为空时，输出与结果 1 相同"; decision row: "配不上任何回答的备注不输出".

rulings.decision: A paired note whose text collapses to empty after whitespace folding is not merged; the line has no bracket.
rulings.basis: Decision row 「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」: "折叠后为空的不并入"; 结果 3: "备注文本折叠后为空时，输出与结果 1 相同".

rulings.decision: A note pairs with an answer only when both `name` and `question` are equal; a note matching on just one of the two is an orphan and is not output.
rulings.basis: Decision row 「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」: "与回答按 `name` 和 `question` 同时相同配对 … 配不上任何回答的备注不输出"; rationale: host `describeAnswer` pairs by `name` + `question`.

rulings.decision: A `details` that fits neither the host shape (`answers[]`) nor the legacy shapes (`results[]`, single `{question, selectedOptions}`) makes `askAnswers` return null. `answers[]` is parsed as the host's shape, not as an unknown shape.
rulings.basis: 结果 4: "非 `ask` 工具、`isError: true`、两种形状都不成立的 `details` 仍返回 `null`".

rulings.decision: These two surfaces are not observable by calling the module. The consumers only use `askAnswers`/`formatAskAnswers` unchanged (turn-judge before() at index.ts:565-566, livePrompts() at user-prompt-inject/index.ts:301-302), so the module's output contract is what the gates check: the first result yields `Database → SQLite`, and the `timedOut: true` result yields null so no `用户在ask中回答` entry and no `{{ask_answers}}` block appear. Observing the real timeline entry and the `<ask_answer index="0">` block in a session belongs to the tree's overall acceptance issue oh-my-omp/omp-config#337; no runtime case here.
rulings.basis: 结果 1/2 and 影响 section: "turn-judge、user-prompt-inject … 只消费 `askAnswers` 与 `formatAskAnswers`，不改"; 依赖关系: "Blocks: oh-my-omp/omp-config#337（总体验收在真实会话里观察原生 `ask` 的作答进入 turn-judge 时间线与被注入的 `{{ask_answers}}`）".

slices.title: Read the host `answers[]` ask details in `_shared/ask-answers.ts`: timedOut gating, note pairing, blank-answer skipping, schema tied to `AskToolDetails`
slices.done_when: `SRC=<PR checkout> bun /tmp/a4-ask.ts` exits 0 with `native` = "Database → SQLite\nBackfill → no", `notes` = that first line plus " [note: SQLite — only if backups stay] [note: SQLite — and WAL on]", `timedOut`/`blankAnswer`/`emptyAnswers` null, `notTimedOut` = "Backfill → no", `persisted` = [native] and the legacy/other/error readings unchanged (rows 1–5), and `bun run check && bun run test` exits 0 with the `answers[]` schema annotated `zod.ZodLikeSchema<AskToolDetails>` from `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/tools/ask` so a host shape change is a type error rather than another silent null (row 6).

rulings.decision: A whitespace-only native `answer` is blank and is skipped. Native answer text is folded first (runs of whitespace incl. newlines/tabs → one space, trimmed); an answer that is empty after folding is 未作答. With that as the only entry, `askAnswers` returns null.
rulings.basis: Contract decision row 「原生答案为空时的表现」: "空白答案按未作答跳过；全部为空或 `answers: []` 返回 `null`"; the existing code already treats blank legacy input the same way (`answerOf` trims `customInput` and returns null when nothing is left, so the entry is dropped). Treating `"   "` as an answer would produce the `question → ` content-free line that the row rejects as 「没有内容的『回答』」.

rulings.decision: No deduplication: one output line per non-blank `answers[]` entry, in host order, even when two entries have the same `name` and `question`. A note pairs with every entry whose `name` and `question` both match it.
rulings.basis: Contract 结果 1: "`details.answers[]` 里的每个作答问题在 `formatAskAnswers` 输出中占一行 … `askAnswers` 返回全部作答" — the host emits one `FormAnswer` per field (data.ts:230-243) and `askAnswers` returns all of them; dropping an entry would lose an operator submission the host recorded, and the nearest similar case (legacy `results[]`, which is also not deduplicated) keeps every entry.

rulings.decision: The one-line-per-question rule holds for native answers: the answer text is folded the same way note text is (newlines and runs of whitespace become a single space, trimmed). The fold applies only to `answers[]` text; legacy `results[]`/single-question parsing stays byte-for-byte as the base commit (结果 4), so a legacy `customInput` is not folded.
rulings.basis: Contract 结果 1: "每个作答问题在 `formatAskAnswers` 输出中占一行 `question → answer`" and 目标 "每个作答问题一行"; the consumers (turn-judge before(), livePrompts(), transcript answerTexts()) join `formatAskAnswers` output as-is, so a textarea newline would otherwise break the line contract. Nearest similar case: the decision table folds 换行与连续空白 to one space for note text. 结果 4 [保持] limits the fold to the new shape.

rulings.decision: A `notes` array in which no entry pairs with an answer changes nothing: the output equals the one without `notes`, and the orphan note is not printed.
rulings.basis: 结果 3: "没有 `notes`、备注全部配不上、或备注文本折叠后为空时，输出与结果 1 相同"; decision row: "配不上任何回答的备注不输出".

rulings.decision: A paired note whose text collapses to empty after whitespace folding is not merged; the line has no bracket.
rulings.basis: Decision row 「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」: "折叠后为空的不并入"; 结果 3: "备注文本折叠后为空时，输出与结果 1 相同".

rulings.decision: A note pairs with an answer only when both `name` and `question` are equal; a note matching on just one of the two is an orphan and is not output.
rulings.basis: Decision row 「宿主的 `notes`（选项备注）去向」: "与回答按 `name` 和 `question` 同时相同配对 … 配不上任何回答的备注不输出"; rationale: host `describeAnswer` pairs by `name` + `question`.

rulings.decision: A `details` that fits neither the host shape (`answers[]`) nor the legacy shapes (`results[]`, single `{question, selectedOptions}`) makes `askAnswers` return null. `answers[]` is parsed as the host's shape, not as an unknown shape.
rulings.basis: 结果 4: "非 `ask` 工具、`isError: true`、两种形状都不成立的 `details` 仍返回 `null`".

rulings.decision: These two surfaces are not observable by calling the module. The consumers only use `askAnswers`/`formatAskAnswers` unchanged (turn-judge before() at index.ts:565-566, livePrompts() at user-prompt-inject/index.ts:301-302), so the module's output contract is what the gates check: the first result yields `Database → SQLite`, and the `timedOut: true` result yields null so no `用户在ask中回答` entry and no `{{ask_answers}}` block appear. Observing the real timeline entry and the `<ask_answer index="0">` block in a session belongs to the tree's overall acceptance issue oh-my-omp/omp-config#337; no runtime case here.
rulings.basis: 结果 1/2 and 影响 section: "turn-judge、user-prompt-inject … 只消费 `askAnswers` 与 `formatAskAnswers`，不改"; 依赖关系: "Blocks: oh-my-omp/omp-config#337（总体验收在真实会话里观察原生 `ask` 的作答进入 turn-judge 时间线与被注入的 `{{ask_answers}}`）".
